intent: Write the cp-00 workshop stage plan: scaffold, skills and both Workers running locally.
changes: created: "Scaffold and skills, running locally", 3 phases, 1 decisions

plan.title: Scaffold and skills, running locally
plan.author: pratos with Claude Code
plan.summary: A fresh clone runs two Workers with one command, before any product exists. This stage lays the ground every later stage and every agent stands on: the layout, a pinned toolchain, the recipes, the lint boundary, the skills and hooks, and the architecture map.
plan.current: An empty repository. This is the first stage, so there is no earlier branch; nothing here is specific to Greenhouse yet.
discoveries: `apps/web/vite.config.ts` runs the API as an auxiliary Worker, so one `vite dev` serves both and the `API` binding works locally.
The web Worker reaches data only through `env.API`, calling `https://api/<path>`; `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts` is the one place that does it.
`/healthz` carries two versions: `label` from the `GIT_DESCRIBE` var for people, `id` from the `VERSION` metadata binding for `wrangler rollback`.
`bun scripts/arch.ts --coverage` refuses any folder under `apps/` or `packages/` that the doc's "Where it lives" table does not name.
`just agent-ready` checks files and recipes, never judgement; here it reports gaps for `just seed`, seeded accounts, test logins, sign-in and an admin route.
plan.endState: On a fresh clone, `just up` serves http://localhost:3000. Its `/healthz` shows the web and api versions, the api's fetched through the binding; `/readyz` reaches D1. `just agent-ready` lists what is still missing, honestly.
notDoing: Deploying anywhere; cp-01 adds the deploy script, CI and rollback.
Domain words, events or accounts; cp-02 names them and cp-03 builds them.
Tables; the D1 binding exists, but no migration does until cp-03.
Product pages; the web app serves health and a placeholder home page only.
plan.approach: Toolchain first, so every later command is the same on every laptop. Then the two Workers and their health. Then the guard rails that keep later stages honest: the lint boundary, the map, the hooks.

steps.caption: The browser asks the web Worker, which holds no data of its own.
The web Worker forwards the request to the API over the binding.
Only the API talks to D1, so its rules apply to every read.
The answer comes back the same way, one door each direction.
The web Worker reads D1 itself for a page, skipping the API.
Writes still go through the API, so reads and writes follow different rules.

phases.name: Toolchain: one shell, one set of recipes
phases.goal: `nix develop` gives the same tools on every laptop and sandbox; `just install` installs and links every skill; `just --list` shows this stage's recipes.

changes.intent: A devShell with bun, nodejs_24, just, jq, curl, git and uv; `node_modules/.bin` on PATH.
Committed, so every clone resolves the same nixpkgs.
Bun workspaces `apps/*` and `packages/*`; wrangler, oxlint and typescript pinned as dev dependencies.
Strict compiler settings that every app and package extends.
Covers `node_modules`, `dist`, `.wrangler` and `.dev.vars*`, the entries `just agent-ready` checks.
Every runnable thing is a recipe, quiet on success; `just` alone lists them.

contract.code:
skills          # vendor pinned skills, link ours and theirs into .claude/skills and .pi/skills
install: skills # bun install, viz-explainer deps, git config core.hooksPath scripts/git-hooks
up: install migrate-local   # cd apps/web && bun run dev → http://localhost:3000
test            # bun test over the packages that exist
lint            # oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --type-aware, then tsc --noEmit
migrate-local   # cd apps/api && wrangler d1 migrations apply greenhouse --local
reset           # rm -rf apps/*/.wrangler/state, then just migrate-local
arch            # bun scripts/arch.ts → docs/architecture/index.html
arch-check      # bun scripts/arch.ts --coverage && --check
agent-ready     # skills/agent-ready/scripts/check.sh

changes.intent: The rules no lint can hold, as on main; `CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to it.
One task end to end in nine steps, each with who and the recipe.

phases.name: Guard rails: the boundary, the map, the hooks
phases.goal: A database import under `apps/web` fails `just lint`. `just arch` builds the map from the doc. Hooks rebuild it on edit and print agent-ready gaps.

changes.intent: An `apps/web/**` override bans domain and database imports, citing the architecture doc.
The Mermaid map, walkthrough, "Where it lives" and "Allowed edges" for two Workers and D1.
Builds `docs/architecture/index.html`; `--coverage` and `--check` fail on an unnamed folder or stale map.
Third-party skills pinned by commit: cloudflare, wrangler, durable-objects, impeccable, animate, stagehand-browse and more.
`just skills`: vendor each pinned skill into `skills/vendor/`, then link every skill for both agents.
Ours: create-plan, viz-explainer, scaffold, ddd-vocabulary, event-sourcing, agent-ready, slop-guard, accident-or-essence.
PostToolUse runs both hooks on every edit; SessionStart prints the agent-ready gaps.
Rebuilds the map or a plan page; refuses, with exit 2, an unmapped app.
Never blocks; prints open gaps at session start and after edits to files it checks.
